subject_line: Three neighbours on the Kāpiti Coast in The Mires
email_body:
Dear Tina,

I was struck by the way The Mires brings Keri, Janet and Sera together in one small block of units on the Kāpiti Coast, three women whose lives began in different countries and decades. In your Read NZ conversation you spoke about the mosque attack bringing the novel's darkest strand closer to home.

I'd love to ask how you balanced that social realism with the touch of swamp magic running underneath.

The Author Ledger is an independent project featuring short Author Spotlights. Each portrait is developed through a few written questions you can answer at your own pace, and the full text is shared with you for review before publication.

Would you be open to taking part? No pressure either way.

Best regards,
The Author Ledger
hook_note: The Mires (Ultimo, 2024) follows three women neighbours in Kāpiti Coast units; written while living on Kāpiti; Ockham 2025 fiction shortlist; Read NZ interview on mosque attack/racism strand (search results).
